description: Les vélos detectés à Issy-les-Moulineaux: comparaison entre 2019 et 2020 (base mensuelle) is a dataset listed in Issy-les-moulineaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville d'Issy-les-Moulineaux. Le nombre de vélos détectés à Issy-les-Moulineaux sur les voies departementales et sur 4 points (Pont d'Issy SUD et NORD, Quai Roosevelt et Boulevard Rodin). Coverage: Issy-les-Moulineaux. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. The portal shows 176 records. The portal shows 2020-06-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-issy-com-portal.
